program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let* ((start (first (find-color g 2)))
         (arrow (first (find-color g 1))))
    (define visited (make-hash))
    (let loop ((r (first start)) (c (second start))
               (dr (- (first arrow) (first start)))
               (dc (- (second arrow) (second start)))
               (out g))
      (let ((state (list r c dr dc)))
        (if (hash-has-key? visited state)
            out
            (begin
              (hash-set! visited state #t)
              (let ((nr (+ r dr)) (nc (+ c dc)))
                (cond
                  [(not (in-bounds? nr nc (rows g) (cols g))) out]
                  [(= (at g nr nc) 5) out]
                  [else
                   (let* ((cell (at g nr nc))
                          (out2 (if (= cell 0) (set-cell out nr nc 8) out))
                          (ndr (cond [(= cell 4) (- dc)] [(= cell 6) dc] [else dr]))
                          (ndc (cond [(= cell 4) (- dr)] [(= cell 6) dr] [else dc])))
                     (loop nr nc ndr ndc out2))]))))))))
